source_status.exact_result: Unverified universal characterization for products of two finite embedded balanced rational pure graphs with positive real weights and rank-one local nonnegative relation cones: all positive-growth actual-PC references and bounded real-PA obstacles have finite rational-domain PAPC/regularizable raw envelopes and complete contact exactly when at least one factor is unbranched. If both branch, a permitted entire-graph construction has P_gamma(u)=gamma and full integral -8ab, where a,b are the actual local primitive-relation scales.
concrete_gaps: Original P05.2's classification of individual fixed arbitrary balanced pairs (X,gamma) remains open; this is a universal-over-references graph-product subclass only.
Individual references on two branched factors are not classified, and all-obstacle regularity on these negative products is not asserted.
Higher-dimensional singular-fan contact under combined intrinsic smoothness and strict positivity remains unresolved.
Extra affine factors, literal coefficient categories, analytic realizations and P06.2 are not addressed.
The proof draft has no independent mathematical certification; exact diagnostic execution and two PDF compilations do not establish correctness.
